title: Allow bare effect expressions in the REPL
description: Enable REPL input such as print "hello" without requiring the file-mode val _ = declaration, while keeping file parsing unchanged.
close_reason: REPL-mode parsing now accepts bare print and POSIX exit expressions while file parsing remains declaration-only.

title: Make the REPL the default frontend
description: Start the JIT REPL when Nassau is invoked without a source file, while retaining file compilation when a path is provided.
close_reason: Nassau now starts the REPL with no source argument and compiles when given a file path.

title: Add a Cranelift JIT REPL frontend
description: Add an interactive frontend that parses and executes currently supported SML declaration chunks using Cranelift JIT while sharing parsing and lowering with native compilation.
close_reason: Added a shared Cranelift code-generation path with a JIT-backed REPL frontend for supported SML chunks.

title: Discover all SML test fixtures
description: Update the MLton oracle integration test to discover and compare every SML source fixture in tests/fixtures instead of naming a single fixture.
close_reason: The oracle test now discovers each .sml fixture under tests/fixtures and compares each against MLton.

title: Use POSIX exit signature and compare against MLton
description: Support Posix.Process.exit (Word8.fromInt n) in the SML subset and extend the integration harness to compare Nassau and MLton stdout and process status for the same fixture.
close_reason: Nassau now accepts the Basis-qualified POSIX exit form and integration tests compare stdout and status against MLton.

title: Add print and exit compiler builtins
description: Add temporary SML builtins for printing strings and terminating with an integer exit code, so the compiler has a runnable baseline before the Basis Library exists.
close_reason: Implemented temporary print and exit builtins with lexer/parser/codegen modules and span-based diagnostics.

title: Add Clap backend debugging options
description: Replace manual CLI parsing with clap and expose backend diagnostics: IR dumps, verification, optimization level, timings, stats, textual assembly, and object disassembly.
close_reason: Replaced manual parsing with clap and added IR dumps, verification, optimization levels, timings, stats, assembly output, and objdump mode.

title: Add target assembly output mode
description: Add --asm to emit Cranelift's target-specific lowered instruction listing to a .S file instead of linking an executable.
acceptance_criteria: --asm writes a .S file and does not invoke the linker; normal binary compilation and --debug-passes remain functional; documentation explains the emitted listing.
close_reason: Added --asm mode, documented its disassembly semantics, and verified binary/debug modes remain functional.

title: Add Cranelift debug pass output flag
description: Add a CLI flag that exposes Cranelift IR and post-lowering instruction output for debugging without changing normal compilation.
acceptance_criteria: Normal compilation remains unchanged; --debug-passes emits useful compiler-stage output; tests cover flag behavior or the exposed output path.
close_reason: Added --debug-passes with pre/post-optimization IR and lowered machine instruction output, documented and tested.
